修复 SVG fallback 证书版式，补齐 OpenClaw 触发与文档说明

- Initial release of gigo-lobster-doctor skill.
- Provides an "environment doctor" mode that checks gateway access, Python dependencies, task-bundle path, and PNG certificate capability without running a full benchmark.
- Supports trigger phrases in both Chinese and English.
- Adheres to strict execution and monitoring rules for consistent operation and log handling.
- Defaults to non-interactive, environment-only checks; benchmark and upload are not run unless specially requested.
